holdout_notice: These experiments used different frozen holdouts. Values should be interpreted within each experiment, not compared directly across phases.

phase1c.label: Phase 1C — Public Baseline Evaluation
phase1c.conclusion: The combined detector improved aggregate F1 and event recall but increased false alerts. The simpler threshold baseline remains the recommended operational candidate.
phase1c.disclaimer: These are research-prototype results on anonymized public telemetry, not operational spacecraft-validation results.
limitations: Telemanom telemetry is anonymized and pre-scaled upstream.
Public training arrays have no official interval labels.
The twenty-channel frozen holdout is not an operational qualification.
The public-data evaluation is offline and is not a live telemetry stream.

phase4.label: Phase 4 — Deep Learning Experiment

experiment.status: Experimental; not used by the live prototype

gates.label: Macro F1 improves by at least 0.02
False alerts stay within 125% of baseline

phase4.conclusion: The LSTM produced fewer false alerts but substantially lower sensitivity and longer median detection delay.
